Accutech Mold & Machine

Accutech Mold & Machine is a job shop in Muncie, Indiana building injection molds and precision tooling. We are ISO 9001:2015 certified and AS9100D registered.

Industries we serve include automotive, medical device, and aerospace customers across the Midwest.

Call us at (765) 555-0142 or visit 1400 Industrial Parkway, Muncie.
